summary: The filing is an 8-K by Ford Credit Floorplan LLC, Ford Credit Floorplan Corporation, and Ford Credit Floorplan Master Owner Trust A, reporting entry into material definitive agreements in connection with an asset-backed securities (ABS) issuance by the Trust. The notes were issued under a Prospectus dated May 5, 2026, with standard transaction documents including an indenture supplement and account control agreement. This represents a routine securitization issuance (floorplan financing), not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The registrant is the depositor/sponsor in a typical ABS deal.
